description: This file defines the MessageCommandResponseAdapter class, which extends AbstractAdapter and implements ThingMessageAdapter. It handles the conversion between MessageCommandResponse objects and adaptable representations, specifically for command response messages in the Ditto protocol. The class includes methods for creating instances, mapping signals to adaptables, and determining message types based on adaptable properties.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: Final class that adapts MessageCommandResponse messages for processing, mapping them to and from adaptable forms, based on type identification via subject or feature ID.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new MessageCommandResponseAdapter instance with the specified HeaderTranslator.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a MessageCommandResponse object into an Adaptable, defaulting to the LIVE channel.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter handles response messages, returning true.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter requires the message subject to determine message type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the message type ('claim', 'feature', or 'thing') based on properties of the Adaptable.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a MessageCommandResponse signal to an Adaptable representation using a signal mapper.
